provenance: Agent-authored development cases based on CC BY 4.0 sources: unicameral and aneurysmal bone cyst reviews, the UK British Sarcoma Group consensus guideline, and a 2026 intraosseous knee tumour imaging review. Targeted to bilingual retrieval; not independently reviewed. Added 4 agent-authored development questions for the licensed 2025 appendicular radiography review; not independently reviewed. Added 4 agent-authored questions on the CC BY 4.0 Society of Skeletal Radiology Bone-RADS white paper; not independently reviewed.

questions.evidence_quote: The purpose of this study was to report the outcomes of injecting bone marrow aspirate and demineralized bone matrix

questions.evidence_quote: telangiectatic osteosarcoma and unicameral bone cyst (UBC) are the main differential diagnoses of an ABC

questions.question_vi: Nếu chẩn đoán nang xương phình mạch còn nghi ngờ, tổng quan nêu cần xác nhận bằng loại bằng chứng nào?
questions.evidence_quote: If there is doubt in the diagnosis, a tissue diagnosis is necessary.

questions.question_vi: Theo đồng thuận BSG áp dụng tại UK, người nghi ngờ primary malignant bone tumour cần được chuyển đến đâu, và khi nào nên chuyển so với sinh thiết?
questions.evidence_quote: Patients with suspected PMBT should be referred to a commissioned bone sarcoma centre on an urgent cancer pathway. Patients should be referred before biopsy

questions.question_vi: Theo hướng dẫn BSG của UK, phim X-quang bình thường có loại trừ primary malignant bone tumour không?
questions.evidence_quote: A normal X-ray does not exclude PMBT, and an urgent MRI may be required.

questions.question_vi: Which intraosseous lesions does the review include as identifiable on routine knee MRI?
questions.evidence_quote: We have included lesions that we expect will be identifiable on routine knee MRI examinations.

questions.question_vi: Theo review, giant cell tumour of bone thường gặp ở những vị trí nào quanh đầu gối?
questions.evidence_quote: The distal femur and proximal tibia are the commonest locations for giant cell tumour of bone

questions.question_vi: In the knee review, what MRI feature is typical of an ABC, and what may a significant solid component suggest?
questions.evidence_quote: Thin septal enhancement is typical in ABCs (Fig. 16); a significant solid component suggests another primary lesion with ABC-like change

questions.question_vi: Nang xương đơn độc có thể chữa khỏi bằng curcumin không?
What chemotherapy dose should a patient with a simple bone cyst take?
Giá sinh thiết nang xương tại bệnh viện địa phương hôm nay bao nhiêu?
Theo tổng quan, những đặc điểm X-quang nào cùng thông tin người bệnh giúp thu hẹp chẩn đoán phân biệt?
questions.evidence_quote: Combined with patient age, clinical symptoms and biology, and lesion features including location, solitary versus multiplicity, density, margin (transitional zone evaluated with Lodwick-Madewell grading score), and, if present, the type of periosteal reaction and matrix mineralization can narrow the differential diagnosis or offer a likely diagnosis.

questions.question_vi: Which transverse locations within a bone are used to classify a bone lesion in the review?

evidence.section: Transverse location (central, eccentric, intracortical, or juxtacortical)

questions.evidence_quote: Bone lesion can also be subdivided based on the transverse location with a bone as central intramedullary, eccentric intramedullary, intracortical, or juxtacortical

questions.question_vi: How do the specific bone and the longitudinal and transverse location help in evaluating a bone lesion?
questions.evidence_quote: The specific bone of involvement, type of bone (flat versus long), and longitudinal and transverse location within a long bone all help to narrow down the list of likely entities.

questions.question_vi: What does the review say about solitary versus multifocal primary bone lesions?
questions.evidence_quote: Most primary bone lesions will be solitary; however, patients presenting with polyostotic (multifocal) bone lesions have a more limited differential diagnosis

questions.question_vi: According to the Bone-RADS white paper, what patient population and imaging context do the algorithms address?
questions.evidence_quote: The purpose of this article is to present algorithms for the diagnostic management of solitary bone lesions incidentally encountered on computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance (MRI) in adults.

questions.question_vi: What are the four possible Bone-RADS management recommendations?
questions.evidence_quote: Bone-RADS1, leave alone; Bone-RADS2, perform different imaging modality; Bone-RADS3, perform follow-up imaging; Bone-RADS4, biopsy and/or oncologic referral

questions.question_vi: What do the Bone-RADS authors say should take precedence over their flowcharts?
questions.evidence_quote: these flowcharts should never override expert opinion

questions.question_vi: Why did the authors limit their Bone-RADS scope to solitary lesions?
questions.evidence_quote: We limited our scope to solitary lesions because patients with multiple lesions often have metastatic disease or systemic conditions that typically require biopsy and/or oncologic referral.
